format: C++/Python hybrid (Pybind11 bindings for C++ core)
description: This file implements Python bindings for the torch::Generator C++ class, enabling creation, manipulation, and serialization of generator objects within Python. It includes functions for initializing generators, getting/setting state, cloning, and managing device-specific generators.

classes.name: THPGenerator
classes.description: Python wrapper class for torch::Generator, providing methods for generator management and state serialization.

methods.name: THPGenerator_initDefaultGenerator
methods.description: Initializes a Python generator object from a C++ Generator.

methods.name: THPGenerator_dealloc
methods.description: Deallocates a Python generator object, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: THPGenerator_pynew
methods.description: Creates a new Python generator object, parsing device arguments.

methods.name: THPGenerator_getState
methods.description: Retrieves the internal state tensor of the generator.

methods.name: THPGenerator_setState
methods.description: Sets the internal state tensor of the generator.

methods.name: unpack_uint64
methods.description: Unpacks a Python object into a uint64_t, handling overflow and signed/unsigned conversions.

methods.name: THPGenerator_graphSafeGetState
methods.description: Retrieves a graph-safe state of the generator.

methods.name: THPGenerator_graphSafeSetState
methods.description: Sets a graph-safe state of the generator.

methods.name: THPGenerator_cloneState
methods.description: Clones the generator state.

methods.name: THPGenerator_manualSeed
methods.description: Seeds the generator with a specified seed.

methods.name: THPGenerator_setOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset of the generator.

methods.name: THPGenerator_seed
methods.description: Returns the current seed of the generator.

methods.name: THPGenerator_initialSeed
methods.description: Returns the initial seed of the generator.

methods.name: THPGenerator_getOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the current offset of the generator.

methods.name: THPGenerator_get_device
methods.description: Returns the device associated with the generator.

methods.name: THPGenerator_reduce
methods.description: Serializes the generator for pickling.

methods.name: THPGenerator_pickleSetState
methods.description: Restores generator state from a pickled state.

methods.name: THPGenerator_Wrap
methods.description: Wraps a C++ Generator into a Python object.

methods.name: THPGenerator_Unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps a Python generator object into a C++ Generator.

methods.name: THPGenerator_NewWithVar
methods.description: Creates a new Python generator object from a C++ Generator.
